title: Interval Ear Training for Beginners: Getting Started with Ear Training in JustinGuitar
summary: JustinGuitar’s ear-training video introduces beginners to Interval Ear Training as a standalone, beginner-friendly module. It explains why ear training matters for musicianship, outlines how interval awareness strengthens listening and helps singing, and describes a practical path into the module (starting with recognizing simple intervals, using familiar melodies to anchor the sound, and attempting basic tests to track progress). The presenter emphasizes that ear training is optional, but beneficial for overall musicianship, and notes that even some professional players excel without formal ear training or music theory. The video also frames interval work as a training gym for the ear and previews how later steps in the course build toward singing in tune and identifying melodies or chords on the guitar.
